messages:
Maria: Heads-up — proposing we lift the runtime pin for hosted-runtime v3.2 on EU canary tonight 06:00–08:00 UTC. KV-cache fix merged and smoke looks clean.
Hazel: What's the rollback plan if we see long-tail latency spikes or error blips?
Maria: Good q. Plan: automatic abort if p95 latency > 400ms for 5m OR error-rate > 0.5%. Deploy-bot will trigger rollback.
Raj: Note: Node SDKs on canary still pull the legacy shim. We should add a short-lived shim rollout / compat label so we don't surprise customers.
Tim: did a 15-min perf sweep against canary infra earlier — tail latencies fine, no regression on quantized models. :thumbsup:
deploy-bot: [scheduled] lift-pin job created by Maria. job_id=0x9f3a. Watching metrics, will rollback on threshold breach. dashboard: https://deploy/reports/0x9f3a
Hazel: please add a one-line release-note blurb + migration note for Dedicated customers using pinned runtimes.
Maria: will add release-note and patch the docs. I’ll ping eng-platform 30m before go and post the final rollout snippet below.
Raj: LGTM from me. Marking as go unless anyone objects by EOD. :white_check_mark:
